name: sightpress/skeleton
description: Start a new SightPress project: a powerful multi-site, multilingual CMS for everyone, designed with blind and low-vision creators and audiences in mind. Built on modern, object-oriented PHP.

scripts.publish-themes: php bin/sightpress theme:publish-assets --no-interaction || echo "The theme previews were not published: run bin/sightpress theme:publish-assets."

scripts-descriptions.cs-check: Check the code style (PSR-12) without changing files.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit and integration test suites.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the unit suite with coverage; fail below 100% lines or methods or on any coverage ignore annotation.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run every check that must pass before a commit.
scripts-descriptions.fix: Apply Rector refactorings, then fix the code style.
scripts-descriptions.up: Start the local environment (http://localhost:8080) in the background.
scripts-descriptions.site:create: Create a site, for example `composer site:create demo` (asks for the rest).
scripts-descriptions.publish-themes: Write the preview page (and screenshots, where Chromium is installed) of every installed theme to public/themes/, for the admin theme picker.
